cohort: The cohort consisted of low-risk primiparous women who were planning to have a vaginal delivery.
finding: Early postpartum oxytocin levels decreased with epidural anesthesia and showed a negative correlation with postpartum maternity blues and fatigue.
mod_finding: Women who received epidural anesthesia had a significantly higher mean salivary oxytocin level at 1-2 days after birth compared to late pregnancy, and early postpartum oxytocin levels decreased in this group.
gest_age: Measurements were taken at 36-37 and 38-39 gestational weeks.
